realmeCare - 1year Screen Damage Protection Plan for Smartphones Between Rs.40000-49999 (Email Delivery, No Physical Product)

from Service Lee Technologies Pvt. Ltd
₹2,149.00
  • WHY REALME SCREEN PROTECT: This realme Screen protection plan provides coverage which includes screen replacement due to any kind of accidental breakage or damage on the handset.
  • WHAT IS COVERED: This plan Coverage begins when the Customer purchase the Plan for his Mobile Phone (“Device”) and ends on completion of one year from the date of purchase of the Plan (“Plan Term”). This warranty is applicable only on new realme product purchased at Amazon. Only one Screen Damage Repair Request per Device is allowed during the Plan term of 12 (twelve) Months. The Plan and Phone must be bought together with New phones purchased from Amazon.
  • WHAT IS NOT COVERED? Unauthorised repair, Normal wear and tear, cosmetic damages, loss and theft of device, damage caused by intentional conduct. This plan cannot be transferred to another person.
  • HASSLE-FREE REPAIR: No documentation is required from the customer during a claim, a one time deductible of 1800 needs to be paid by the customer to the realme Authorised Service Centre directly. Customers can cancel the policy maximum within 7 working days from the date of purchase.
  • HOW TO RAISE A CLAIM? Schedule a service at your convenience from your Amazon account itself by navigating to Your Orders section in your Amazon account > go to the product order > click on Get Product Support > schedule an appointment. We use genuine spare parts & repairs carried out through realme Authorized service centres.
  • A DIGITAL DELIVERY PRODUCT -- Your plan details will be delivered via email within 2 hours of ordering on your Amazon registered email id (No physical delivery). For any other issue, reach out to Support Email ID: service@realme.com Toll-Free Number: 1800 102 2777

        5 out of 5 stars
        Pretty Solid Phone 📱
        Reviewed in India on 10 July 2025
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Review after 1 month+ usage:

        🔸Display - 10/10

        (Pretty good. Using 1080+ which looks almost similar as QHD and preserves battery.

        🔸Battery - 10/10

        Using 80% limit charging to preserve longevity. Charging speed is very fast. But, i use the 120w only when i am in a hurry. Mostly i use my POCO F3 GT charger, which takes more time to charge but that's good for the battery health.

        🔸OS - 9/10

        Bloatwares can be removed, no bugs noticed yet. Compared to HyperOS, Realme UI is much better, smooth and haven't experienced a single animation glitch as of yet.

        🔸Fingerprint - 8/10

        Takes half second to unlock. Ultrasonic could have been great. But, this optical works pretty good too.

        🔸Camera - 9/10

        Telephoto camera should have been 3X and not 2X!

        Camera quality is good. Blackmagic camera is compatible.

        Photo & video quality is pretty decent. This is have compared with Samsung Galaxy S23FE. Only complaints will be, it needed 3X Telephoto and atleast a good 13MP ultrawide.

        🔸Speaker - 9/10

        Has good loudness and bass. Has almost 50:50 ratio loudness from both speakers, top & bottom.

        🔸Gaming - 9/10 - Can run ANY game at MAX graphics settings

        Grid Legends - Runs good but has random FPS stutters. Maybe Codemasters need to optimize for this chipset. Raw gameplay video is available in Ryukayne Gaming YT Channel.

        GTA San Andreas - Definitive Edition

        Runs at max graphics and doesn't have any noticeable FPS drop.

        Wreckfest Mobile

        Runs at max graphics and doesn't have any noticeable FPS drop.

        🔸Thermals/Temperature: 7/10

        Normal Usage --------

        >Remains pretty cool & doesn't get warm. Mostly under 38°c

        >Using camera also doesn't make the phone warm at all.

        >Social Media, Youtube, 4k 60fps HDR videos doesn't make it warm also.

        Heavy Graphics Game ---------

        Can reach higher temperature when you run heavy graphics games such as Wuthering Waves, GTA SA Definitive Edition, Grid Legends, Wreckfest and similar demanding games. Temperature upto 40°c - 47°c can be felt while running these. You can change graphics settings to Low/Medium and play them without making the phone hot.

        Low/Medium Graphics Game ---------

        Temperature stays under 40°c while playing 2Year+ old games. Such as Diablo Immortal, T3 Arena, COD,

        Well some reviews about this device were too harsh so I was a bit confused whether to buy it or not . I was initially using a Realme GT Master Edition so switching from my old phone was very smooth . I will go by department by department ratings of this phone .

        1. Processor 10/10 : Quite fast at this price point(9400e) , though IQOO Neo 10 is already giving almost that(8s Gen4) at a lower price . For 99% tasks , you won't even need this much amount of processor perf but may help in intensive gaming sessions .

        2. Battery and Charging 9.5/10 : Battery life is actually very good . A moderate usage will last for around 1.5 days . Charging is also seriously fast , though it will definitely reduce the effective battery capacity in future . Also it is a first gen silicon-carbon battery so maybe there are potential risks as well in future . (You can think of OP 13R since it has Li-ion battery)

        3. Camera 8/10 : Decent camera , 2x telephoto lens is disappointing in this price point (ik this is kinda gaming focused) . But it clicks good enough pics from primary lens . Camera is not it's USP I'm telling you .

        4. Software 8.5/10 : It shares the same codebase with Oppo's ColorOS and OnePlus's OxygenOS , so most of the features are common . But just like OnePlus did more overhaul over the base ColorOS , Realme didn't do any such brand specific optimizations . But software is better than FuntouchOS found in Vivo/IQOO devices (I have used them as well) but definitely ranks below OneUI . Animations are fast and customizable as well .

        5. Other features : LPDDR5X ram works fantastic and UFS 4.0 storage is pretty fast . It has an IR BLASTER which is handy in many cases . Speakers are loud enough . Display is gorgeous as usual in this price range but not sure about the 6000 nits peak brightness maybe a marketing gimmick . Otherwise HBM is good , visible under sunlight , also has an option for Extra brightness in the settings that draws more power.

        *** P.S. In my unit , I didn't face any heating issues except a little bit during charging (normal for 120W). For small gaming sessions like 30-40 mins , it easily handled COD at full graphics settings without noticeable heating . Just after buying this , I got two small software updates in two days .

        *** May write a long term future review as well

        Realme GT 7 – Super Impressed!
        Reviewed in India on 22 June 2025
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Been using the Realme GT 7 for a bit now, and honestly, it's been a great experience so far.

        Speed & Performance:

        This thing is fast. Apps open instantly, no lags while switching between apps or playing games. Everything just feels super smooth.

        Display & Sound:

        The display is beautiful with vibrant colors, sharp details, and great brightness. Watching videos or scrolling through social media looks amazing. The sound is also surprisingly good, loud and clear, for media consumption.

        Camera:

        The camera is pretty solid for the price. Photos are a bit on the contrasty and saturated side, but I actually like that look. Makes pics pop, especially on social media.

        Network:

        What really blew me away is the network reception. Compared to my old S21 FE, this one is way better. I get strong, stable 5G pretty much everywhere now. No more random drops or weak signals.

        Overall:

        Honestly, for the price, the Realme GT 7 is a total win. Fast, great screen and sound, solid camera, and amazing network stability. Totally worth it.
